task: Analyze MATBG core dataset to extract dc resistance/proxy, microwave resonance/proxy, and superfluid stiffness dependencies on carrier density/gate voltage, temperature, and current.
primary_quantities: carrier-density dependence vs conventional Fermi-liquid and quantum-geometric predictions
temperature power-law exponent and comparison to BCS/nodal/power-law models
assumptions: The provided core dataset is simulated and contains D_s arrays directly; resistance and resonance are treated through standard monotonic proxies because raw R_dc and f_res are not separately tabulated.
Carrier density is used as a gate-voltage proxy; microwave current amplitude is derived from normalized microwave power.
required_outputs: temperature dependence and power-law fit figure
current dependence and quadratic validation figure
